stories.title: "I was being very normal about these until I saw them stack"
stories.summary: When design account @dollbodydoesoul shared photos of ceramic cups by Sara Gaia, the individual vessel seemed innocent enough—until the second slide showed them stacked into a curvy, bamboo-joint silhouette. The post amassed over 720K likes as users marveled at the suggestive silhouette created by nesting ceramics.
